interface_execution.lineage_success: semantic response exists AND common envelope parses AND all three case route traces name the supplied policy AND route/rule/action IDs are mechanically consistent with that policy and supplied inputs AND no impossible or dangling identifier appears

reference_target_compatibility.working: Both evaluators independently score A>=5/6 AND B>=5/6 AND C>=5/6 on REFERENCE_M1
reference_target_compatibility.partial: Not working, and both evaluators independently score A>=3/6 AND at least two of A/B/C>=3/6 on REFERENCE_M1

incremental_policy_effect.control_observed: A lineage M0_ONLY control is observed only when its semantic response exists and its common response envelope parses with exactly A, B, and C
incremental_policy_effect.chain_per_lineage_evaluator: REFERENCE_M1_A AND NOT M0_ONLY_A AND REFERENCE_M1_B AND REFERENCE_M1_C
incremental_policy_effect.supported: For both evaluators independently: controls observed 6/6 AND M0_ONLY_A<=1/6 AND CHAIN>=5/6
incremental_policy_effect.when_6_of_6_observed_but_support_thresho: Return no incremental-effect conclusion marker; retain raw counts and record that the preregistered support threshold was not met. Do not infer causality.
incremental_policy_effect.M0_PLUS_E1: descriptive only; excluded from primary thresholds

missing_evaluator_rows: false for the affected evaluator and target; preserve raw row
missing_or_invalid_successor_output: false raw endpoint; retain in denominator
